risk_if_not_implemented: Without On-Site Client Segregation, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical Access Control
compensating_control_1.description: Physical access control mechanisms exist to enforce physical access authorizations for all physical access points (including designated entry/exit points) to facilities (excluding those areas within the facility officially designated as publicly accessible).
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical Access Control (PES-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of On-Site Client Segregation (PES-11.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Network Segmentation (macrosegmentation)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to implement network segmentation within network architectures to isolate Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) from other network resources.
compensating_control_2.justification: Network Segmentation (macrosegmentation) (NET-06) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of On-Site Client Segregation (PES-11.1) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
